NetworkPath.description: Road network path (ordered sequence of links).

typeId.description: Path type classification (e.g. bus route, diversion).
typeId.title: TypeId

permanent.description: Whether this is a permanent or temporary path.

items.description: Unique identifier of an object. String of 1-32 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and . _ : - (no spaces), unique within object type within system.
items.title: ObjectId

linkIds.description: Ordered links defining the path. List order is the route sequence. Omit the field rather than send an empty list. A link may appear more than once, since a route can traverse the same link twice.

initialTrimMeters.description: Distance to trim from the start of the first link.

finalTrimMeters.description: Distance to trim from the end of the last link.

NetworkPath.title: UTMC Network Path
